usage: roborepo skill symlink-repo    [--dry-run] [--uninstall]   link this repo's .agents/skills into its .claude/.codex
roborepo skill symlink-globals [--check]                   link shared global skills into the global harness folders
roborepo skill render-commands [--check]                   render/check slash commands
roborepo project-context inventory [path] [--summary]   scan a repo and write generated facts
roborepo telemetry install                 wire only capture hooks (no full roborepo required)
roborepo telemetry start                  enable capture + start detached dashboard
roborepo telemetry stop                   stop detached dashboard + disable capture
roborepo telemetry serve [--detach] [--port <n>]   dashboard only (power-user; capture state unchanged)
roborepo telemetry backup                snapshot the spool to a timestamped backup
roborepo telemetry purge --all [--backup] reset telemetry (optionally back up first)
roborepo repair  [--dry-run]  relink managed install after the repo was moved/renamed
roborepo backfill              pull live config back into the repo
roborepo rules   [--check]     render/check generated agent rules
roborepo permissions [--check] [--profile <name>] render/check agent permission outputs
[path] is optional (defaults to the current directory) and may be relative or absolute.
